Package io.telekom.orchest.enginecore.bpmn.service

Class UserTaskService

java.lang.Object
io.telekom.orchest.enginecore.bpmn.service.UserTaskService
public class UserTaskService extends Object
Service for managing User Task lifecycle operations. Implements Camunda 8 compatible user task semantics including:
  • Task creation with assignment (assignee, candidateUsers, candidateGroups)
  • Task claiming by authorized users
  • Task unclaiming (release back to pool)
  • Task completion with output variables
  • Task reassignment
  • Authorization checks based on assignment configuration

    • createUserTask

      public io.telekom.orchest.api.core.adapters.data.model.UserTaskInstance createUserTask(String processInstanceId, String processDefinitionId, io.telekom.orchest.api.core.model.bpmn.node.UserTaskNode userTaskNode, Map<String,Object> variables)
      Creates a new user task instance when the engine reaches a User Task node. If an assignee is defined, the task is automatically claimed for that user.
      Parameters:
      processInstanceId - The process instance ID.
      processDefinitionId - The process definition ID.
      userTaskNode - The User Task node definition.
      variables - The process variables at the time of task creation.
      Returns:
      The created user task instance.

    • claimTask

      public io.telekom.orchest.api.core.adapters.data.model.UserTaskInstance claimTask(String taskId, String userId, List<String> userGroups)
      Claims a user task for the specified user. The user must be authorized (assignee, candidateUser, or member of candidateGroup).
      Parameters:
      taskId - The unique task ID.
      userId - The user claiming the task.
      userGroups - The groups the user belongs to (from JWT/auth context).
      Returns:
      The updated user task instance.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the task is not found.
      IllegalStateException - if the task is not in CREATED state or user is not authorized.

    • unclaimTask

      public io.telekom.orchest.api.core.adapters.data.model.UserTaskInstance unclaimTask(String taskId, String userId)
      Unclaims a user task, releasing it back to the candidate pool. Only the user who claimed the task (or an admin) can unclaim it.
      Parameters:
      taskId - The unique task ID.
      userId - The user unclaiming the task.
      Returns:
      The updated user task instance.

    • completeTask

      public io.telekom.orchest.api.core.adapters.data.model.UserTaskInstance completeTask(String taskId, String userId)
      Marks a user task as completed. The user must have claimed the task first. Returns the completed task — the engine will then call resumeActivity() to continue the process.
      Parameters:
      taskId - The unique task ID.
      userId - The user completing the task.
      Returns:
      The completed user task instance.

    • isUserAuthorized

      public boolean isUserAuthorized(io.telekom.orchest.api.core.adapters.data.model.UserTaskInstance task, String userId, List<String> userGroups)
      Checks if a user is authorized to interact with a user task. A user is authorized if:
      • They are the assignee of the task
      • They are in the candidateUsers list
      • Any of their groups matches a candidateGroup
      • There are no assignment restrictions (open task)
      Parameters:
      task - The user task instance.
      userId - The user identifier.
      userGroups - The groups the user belongs to.
      Returns:
      true if the user is authorized.
